adjust_annotation_positions: adjust annotation text positions on a polar axes to prevent overlapping in a circos plot
sort_annotations_by_quadrant: sort matplotlib annotation texts by quadrant and radian position for circos plot layout
check_rad_shift_target_location: check if an annotation radian position is a target for automatic radial shift adjustment
get_rad_shift_candidates: get candidate radian shift positions for annotation text based on neighboring annotations
